text:
Anya: Quick sync 10d to GA. We need a concise 'finality' checklist that teams can sign off on. SLA language, docs freeze, support coverage, monitoring alerts, pricing runway. Who volunteers to draft each piece?
Priya: I can draft the sign-off checklist template and capture acceptance criteria per owner. Will include a triage severity matrix.
Len: I'll take SLA numbers + rollback criteria. Proposal: Hosted GA SLA 99.9% uptime, p99 latency target 350ms soft, 600ms hard. Dedicated GA SLA 99.95%, p99 280ms/450ms. Curious about maintenance window policy?
Marco: Ops input 1: maintenance windows should be pre-announced for Dedicated with 48h notice; Hosted gets rolling maintenance with 4h advance notice in console. We'll add an exception clause for emergency ops.
Kat: Docs: I'll own the developer-facing change log and the migration guide. Need a stable API spec by EOD Fri so examples don't drift. Also will write an "if things go wrong" quick-runbook snippet for Support.
Sam: Pricing: ask Finance to approve provisional GA tiers. Proposal: Developer (metered, free tier), Standard (metered with higher throughput), Enterprise (committed capacity). Add optional "burst credits" buy-up for dev/standard. I need cost-per-token estimates from Len.
Ryan: Legal: I'll prepare an SLA appendix and a short pilot SOW template. Need product to flag any features that are not covered by SLA (beta flags, private preview).
Anya: Good. Action items: Checklist template -> Priya, SLA numbers & cost -> Len, Maintenance policy -> Marco, Docs -> Kat, Pricing proposal -> Sam, Legal wording -> Ryan. I'll post a GH checklist and label owners.
Len: I'll run targeted perf tests Tue/Wed. If p99 is above soft target, we should allow a temporary slow-path (degraded throughput) with clear comms. I'll include perf logs in the GH issue.
Marco: Monitoring: dashboards for p50/p95/p99, requests/sec, error-rate, infra GPU saturation, KV hit rate. Alerts: p99>600ms (prod), error-rate>1% 5m, request-drop>0.5% 5m. We'll add a cost anomaly alert for 30% token-usage delta.
Kat: Docs needs: API diffs, SDK snippets (python/js), quickstart in <5min, migration table, runbook link. Will also generate an FAQ for enterprise negotiation points.
Priya: I'll include a small acceptance checklist per owner: each item must have owner, criteria (pass/fail), evidence link, and rollback plan.
Sam: Finance question: Dedicated customers - flat committed monthly invoice or metered plus commitment discount? Pref flat for GA, but need to model runway. I'll attach a sketch in the GH issue.
Ryan: For GA pilots under NDA, include a pilot addendum clarifying support SLAs and rollback rights. I'll share sample language by Tue.
Anya: Support staffing: propose 72h elevated oncall from GA start with a named eng triage team. Jen is out this week; who covers support rota?
Marco: Ops can staff the initial rota; I'll coordinate with Eng leads to get 2 primary and 2 backups per 24h window.
Len: Note on fallback: ensure a documented fallback to a smaller model variant and cross-region re-route steps. We'll validate during perf tests.
Kat: I'll embed runbook links in the quickstart and include escalation contact cards.
Priya: Timeline: Docs freeze Fri, SLA final Tue, Pricing provisional Wed, Oncall rota confirmed Thu, GA board sign-off Fri. Sound ok?
Anya: Agree. We'll hold a final triage Thurs 11am PT. If any owner cannot meet dates, flag here immediately. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Staging deploy complete (sha d4c3b21). Smoke tests passed.
Anya: Thanks. Priya will spin the checklist GH issue now and ping owners. We'll use this thread for last minute blockers.
